security_model.normal_mode: Exact local approval for normal/customer mutations.
security_model.owner_mode: OAuth role=owner plus workstation-local Owner Full Control; locally revocable.
security_model.filesystem_roots: Normal approved roots can only be expanded locally.
security_model.screen_capture: Generic hosted screen capture remains unpublished.
security_model.secret_input: Passwords, API keys, card data and 2FA values must not be sent through typing or terminal tools.
security_model.remote_owner_approval: OAuth-linked owners may remotely approve one existing exact unexpired approval only when workstation-local Owner Full Control is enabled. The underlying action remains single-use and exact-match bound.

tools.name: commandport_browser_scroll_state
tools.description: Inspect the active browser's vertical scrollability and position without page text, form values, URLs or pixels. Unknown means the browser lacks a usable scroll provider.

tools.name: commandport_capability_report
tools.description: Inspect Project Relay workstation capability categories and dependency availability without executing a mutation or returning secret values.

tools.name: commandport_click
tools.description: Execute only the exact mouse click approved locally. Because a general click can trigger external actions, treat it as potentially destructive.

tools.name: commandport_click_target
tools.description: Click the exact locally approved browser control after checking current identity, geometry and occlusion.

tools.name: commandport_find_target
tools.description: Find exactly one visible browser button or link by its public label. Does not read input values or return page text.

tools.name: commandport_focus_window
tools.description: Bring one existing top-level Windows window to the foreground without clicking or typing.

tools.name: commandport_get_file_info
tools.description: Read metadata for one file or folder inside approved workstation roots.

tools.name: commandport_get_runtime_config
tools.description: Read bounded non-secret Project Relay runtime preferences, executable availability, approved roots and owner-control status.

tools.name: commandport_hash_file
tools.description: Compute SHA-256 for one file inside approved workstation roots without returning file content.

tools.name: commandport_health_report
tools.description: Return one bounded non-sensitive workstation health snapshot covering watchdog freshness, updater/backoff state, rollback availability, startup recovery tasks, and Owner Full Control availability.

tools.name: commandport_launch_app
tools.description: Launch the exact allowlisted app approved locally. A process start does not confirm a ready window; inspect windows afterwards. Never retry automatically after a timeout.

tools.name: commandport_list_directory
tools.description: List files and folders inside approved workstation roots.

tools.name: commandport_list_process_details
tools.description: Owner-routed read-only process details with executable identity and command arguments redacted.

tools.name: commandport_list_processes
tools.description: List local Windows processes without changing them.

tools.name: commandport_list_services
tools.description: Owner-routed read-only Windows service inventory.

tools.name: commandport_list_windows
tools.description: List visible top-level Windows application windows without changing focus.

tools.name: commandport_open_url
tools.description: Open one validated http(s) URL in the linked workstation's default browser. This navigates to an external site but does not click or submit anything.

tools.name: commandport_owner_apply_text_replace
tools.description: Owner Full Control: apply a previewable UTF-8 text replacement with optional expected SHA-256 conflict check and rollback checkpoint.

tools.name: commandport_owner_apply_text_transaction
tools.description: Owner Full Control: atomically stage and apply up to 20 distinct text edits after validating all expected SHA-256 values; restores already-written files if a later replace fails.

tools.name: commandport_owner_approve
tools.description: Owner Full Control: remotely approve one existing unexpired exact approval from an OAuth-linked owner session. Does not execute the action; the original action still consumes the approval once.

tools.name: commandport_owner_event_log_query
tools.description: Owner Full Control: query bounded Windows Event Log entries by log, recent time window and optional level; per-event messages are truncated.

tools.name: commandport_owner_fs_copy
tools.description: Owner Full Control: copy one explicit file or directory to an explicit destination.

tools.name: commandport_owner_fs_delete
tools.description: Owner Full Control: delete one explicit file, or a directory only when recursive is deliberately requested.

tools.name: commandport_owner_fs_mkdir
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create a directory tree at an explicit absolute path.

tools.name: commandport_owner_fs_move
tools.description: Owner Full Control: move or rename one explicit file or directory.

tools.name: commandport_owner_network_summary
tools.description: Owner Full Control: return bounded Windows interface, IP, gateway and DNS diagnostics. Does not scan ports or services.

tools.name: commandport_owner_pdf_delete_pages
tools.description: Owner Full Control: delete explicit one-based PDF pages with optimistic SHA-256 conflict protection; refuses deleting every page.

tools.name: commandport_owner_pdf_insert_pdf
tools.description: Owner Full Control: insert pages from another approved-root PDF into a target PDF at an explicit zero-based position.

tools.name: commandport_owner_power_action
tools.description: Owner Full Control: shutdown, restart, sleep or lock the selected Windows workstation. Requires OAuth owner routing and the workstation-local Owner Full Control switch.

tools.name: commandport_owner_preview_text_replace
tools.description: Owner Full Control: preview a bounded exact/regex text replacement as a unified diff without writing.

tools.name: commandport_owner_preview_text_transaction
tools.description: Owner Full Control: preview up to 20 text edits across distinct approved-root files, returning per-file hashes and bounded unified diffs without writing.

tools.name: commandport_owner_process_start
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start one explicit executable with bounded argument count. No shell expansion is used.

tools.name: commandport_owner_process_terminate
tools.description: Owner Full Control: terminate a specific PID with safeguards against system/self termination.

tools.name: commandport_owner_read_document
tools.description: Owner Full Control: format-aware bounded read of CSV, JSON, XLSX/XLSM, PDF, DOCX or text inside approved roots.

tools.name: commandport_owner_read_file_lines
tools.description: Owner Full Control: read bounded UTF-8 file lines from an approved root with positive pagination or negative tail offsets.

tools.name: commandport_owner_read_image
tools.description: Owner Full Control: read one local image as a bounded JPEG preview for visual inspection; file content is owner-only and the workstation-local Owner Full Control switch must be enabled.

tools.name: commandport_owner_read_multiple_files
tools.description: Owner Full Control: read bounded UTF-8 ranges from up to 20 files inside approved roots. Requires owner OAuth routing and the workstation-local Owner Full Control switch.

tools.name: commandport_owner_recent_tool_calls
tools.description: Owner Full Control: return bounded local tool-call history containing action names and argument shapes only; argument values are never logged.

tools.name: commandport_owner_replace_docx_text
tools.description: Owner Full Control: replace exact text in DOCX paragraphs/tables using a format-aware writer and rollback checkpoint.

tools.name: commandport_owner_rollback_document
tools.description: Owner Full Control: rollback one format-aware document checkpoint only if the current file still matches its post-write hash.

tools.name: commandport_owner_rollback_text_edit
tools.description: Owner Full Control: rollback one Relay text-edit checkpoint only when the current file still matches the checkpoint post-edit hash.

tools.name: commandport_owner_rollback_text_transaction
tools.description: Owner Full Control: rollback an entire Relay multi-file text transaction only when every current file still matches its post-transaction hash.

tools.name: commandport_owner_run_command
tools.description: Owner Full Control: run one bounded PowerShell command on an explicitly owner-linked workstation. Output and timeout remain bounded by the local adapter.

tools.name: commandport_owner_runtime_config
tools.description: Owner Full Control: update bounded runtime preferences such as default shell, blocked command names, output limit and local tool-history preference.

tools.name: commandport_owner_sandbox_run
tools.description: Owner Full Control: execute bounded Python or Node code inside an already-installed Docker image with no network, no host mounts, read-only root, dropped capabilities and CPU/memory/PID limits.

tools.name: commandport_owner_sandbox_status
tools.description: Owner Full Control: inspect whether the fixed Python/Node Docker sandbox images are locally installed and report the hard isolation settings used by Relay.

tools.name: commandport_owner_scheduled_task_action
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start/stop/enable/disable one exact Windows Scheduled Task. Project Relay recovery tasks are protected from remote stop/disable.

tools.name: commandport_owner_scheduled_tasks_list
tools.description: Owner Full Control: list bounded Windows Scheduled Task names, paths and states without action arguments or credentials.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_content
tools.description: Owner Full Control: bounded regex or literal content search across approved roots with file globs and up to five context lines. Binary/oversized files and symlink traversal are skipped.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_document
tools.description: Owner Full Control: search text extracted from a supported document without modifying it.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_list
tools.description: Owner Full Control: list active/recent Relay search sessions and their progress without returning search result contents.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_read
tools.description: Owner Full Control: read a bounded page of results from one background Relay search session. Negative offsets provide tail behavior.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_start
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start a bounded background filename or content search across approved roots. Returns a search-session id for paginated polling.

tools.name: commandport_owner_search_stop
tools.description: Owner Full Control: request cancellation of one background Relay search session.

tools.name: commandport_owner_self_update
tools.description: Owner Full Control: stage only a published stable/beta Project Relay release through the existing checksum-verified rollback-capable updater.

tools.name: commandport_owner_service_action
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start, stop or restart one exact Windows service name.

tools.name: commandport_owner_software_install
tools.description: Owner Full Control: silently install one exact Winget package id.

tools.name: commandport_owner_software_list
tools.description: Owner Full Control: list installed software through Winget with bounded output.

tools.name: commandport_owner_software_search
tools.description: Owner Full Control: search Winget packages with bounded output.

tools.name: commandport_owner_software_uninstall
tools.description: Owner Full Control: uninstall one exact Winget package id.

tools.name: commandport_owner_software_upgrade
tools.description: Owner Full Control: upgrade one exact Winget package id.

tools.name: commandport_owner_ssh_start
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start a passwordless SSH terminal session using key/agent authentication only. Password and keyboard-interactive authentication are disabled and strict host-key checking is required.

tools.name: commandport_owner_system_snapshot
tools.description: Owner Full Control: return bounded OS, CPU-count, boot/memory and home-disk diagnostics for the selected workstation.

tools.name: commandport_owner_terminal_list
tools.description: Owner Full Control: list Relay terminal-session identities and status without exposing command text.

tools.name: commandport_owner_terminal_read
tools.description: Owner Full Control: read bounded paginated output from one Relay terminal session.

tools.name: commandport_owner_terminal_start
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start one bounded interactive terminal session using PowerShell, cmd, WSL, Python, Node or R when installed. This is not a sandbox.

tools.name: commandport_owner_terminal_stop
tools.description: Owner Full Control: terminate one Relay-managed terminal session, optionally its Windows process tree.

tools.name: commandport_owner_terminal_write
tools.description: Owner Full Control: send bounded text to one Relay terminal session. Do not send passwords, tokens, card data or 2FA values.

tools.name: commandport_owner_ui_click_control
tools.description: Owner Full Control: click one exact visible enabled non-password UI Automation control after context checks.

tools.name: commandport_owner_ui_find_control
tools.description: Owner Full Control: find one exact visible enabled non-password UI Automation control without dumping the UI tree.

tools.name: commandport_owner_update_xlsx_cells
tools.description: Owner Full Control: update explicit XLSX/XLSM cell coordinates with optimistic SHA-256 conflict protection and a rollback checkpoint.

tools.name: commandport_owner_update_xlsx_range
tools.description: Owner Full Control: update an exact Sheet!A1:C10 Excel range from a 2D value array with exact dimension checks, optimistic SHA-256 conflict protection and rollback checkpoint.

tools.name: commandport_owner_usage_stats
tools.description: Owner Full Control: return bounded local action counts, success/failure rates and timing aggregates. Argument and output values are never included.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_csv
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create or replace a CSV file using structured rows, with optional expected SHA-256 conflict protection.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_docx
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create or replace a DOCX document from bounded text using a format-aware writer.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_json
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create or replace JSON using structured input and optional expected SHA-256 conflict protection.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_pdf
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create or replace a text PDF using a format-aware writer; generic text writes never touch PDFs.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_text_file
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create, rewrite or append a bounded UTF-8 text file inside approved roots with optional expected SHA-256 conflict protection and rollback checkpoint.

tools.name: commandport_owner_write_xlsx
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create or replace an XLSX workbook from structured worksheet rows, with optional expected SHA-256 conflict protection.

tools.name: commandport_owner_zip_create
tools.description: Owner Full Control: create a ZIP from explicit approved-root files/directories, refusing symlinks and enforcing total file/byte limits.

tools.name: commandport_owner_zip_extract
tools.description: Owner Full Control: extract a ZIP into an approved destination with path-traversal, symlink, single-file, total-size and compression-ratio protections.

tools.name: commandport_owner_zip_list
tools.description: Owner Full Control: inspect a ZIP archive inside approved roots. Rejects traversal and symlink entries and returns bounded metadata only.

tools.name: commandport_ping
tools.description: Ping the selected linked workstation through the Relay task channel and return its current version/host response.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_click
tools.description: Create an exact local approval request for one mouse click at fixed screen coordinates. Does not click.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_click_target
tools.description: Prepare local approval for an exact-label browser button or link click. Never supply secrets as labels.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_launch_app
tools.description: Prepare exact local approval to open Notepad, Calculator or Relay. No paths, documents or custom arguments are accepted.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_run_command
tools.description: Create an exact local approval request for one bounded PowerShell command.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_scroll
tools.description: Prepare a local approval for bounded scroll in the same active window.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_service
tools.description: Prepare exact local approval for a named Windows service action.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_switch_tab
tools.description: Prepare a local approval for tab switch in the same active browser window.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_type_text
tools.description: Create an exact local approval request to type text into the active window. Does not type.

tools.name: commandport_prepare_write_file
tools.description: Create an exact local approval request for one bounded UTF-8 file write.

tools.name: commandport_read_text_file
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 range from a file inside approved workstation roots.

tools.name: commandport_read_url
tools.description: Fetch a bounded public http(s) resource. Rejects credential-shaped URLs and private/loopback/link-local/reserved targets.

tools.name: commandport_run_command
tools.description: Run only the exact PowerShell command/cwd/timeout approved locally.

tools.name: commandport_scroll
tools.description: Execute a locally approved bounded scroll in the same active window.

tools.name: commandport_search_files
tools.description: Search file and folder names inside an approved root with bounded traversal.

tools.name: commandport_search_text
tools.description: Search bounded UTF-8 text content inside approved roots.

tools.name: commandport_service
tools.description: Execute only the exact owner-routed Windows service action approved locally.

tools.name: commandport_switch_tab
tools.description: Execute a locally approved tab switch in the same active browser window.

tools.name: commandport_type_text
tools.description: Type only the exact approved text into the active window, optionally followed by Enter. General typing can submit forms or trigger external actions.

tools.name: commandport_write_file
tools.description: Write only the exact path/content/mode approved locally.

tools.name: execute_bridge_read
tools.description: Execute only a curated read-only action on a trusted capability bridge. Writes and physical actions fail closed.

tools.name: get_bridge
tools.description: Inspect one capability bridge and its declared capabilities.

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Read current metadata for one discovered hardware device.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the stable authenticated Project Relay profile represented by the current OAuth credentials.

tools.name: get_workstation_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect the linked workstation's last advertised actions and which are published by this server. This does not execute them or verify this chat's cached tool list.

tools.name: list_bridges
tools.description: List Project Relay capability bridges and their trust/risk metadata.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the read-only hardware inventory on a paired Project Relay workstation.

tools.name: list_serial_ports
tools.description: List serial/COM devices without opening them.

tools.name: list_workstations
tools.description: List enrolled Project Relay workstations and current online state.

tools.name: pending_approvals
tools.description: List unexpired local Project Relay approval requests waiting for workstation consent.

tools.name: plan_bridge_action
tools.description: Plan a bridge action without executing it; returns risk, approval requirement and executability.

tools.name: supervised_app_status
tools.description: Inspect exact-process status and duplicate count for one locally registered supervised application.

tools.name: supervised_list_apps
tools.description: List locally registered supervised applications without private launch arguments.

tools.name: supervised_owner_restart
tools.description: Owner Full Control: restart one locally registered supervised application by exact executable identity.

tools.name: supervised_owner_start
tools.description: Owner Full Control: start one locally registered supervised application only when no matching instance is running.

hosted_compatibility.note: Public hosted actions must also exist in the device allowlist, local bridge registry and SQL action contract. CI enforces cross-layer consistency.
